elements.element: No minimum purchase commitment imposed on Customer
elements.evidence: "commits to purchase no minimum quantity of Services"

elements.element: Fees payable for usage or ordered services only (no take-or-pay)
elements.evidence: "on a usage or ordered basis, without take-or-pay obligation"

elements.element: Commitment limited to the current 12-month term
elements.evidence: "in each of the next three years" retained; no 12-month limitation (moot at preferred, since no commitment exists)
No notice-based reduction mechanic appears; condition absent because no commitment remains

elements.element: True-up rather than penalty for shortfall
elements.evidence: No true-up language; not required as the take-or-pay minimum is deleted

reasons: Preferred level is fully achieved: the USD 2,000,000 minimum is replaced with "no minimum quantity" and payment is expressly "on a usage or ordered basis, without take-or-pay obligation".

The edit is a single targeted replacement within 2.1; no new exceptions, duplicated protections, or model boilerplate were added, and clause 12.3 (which already confirms no minimum-volume commitment) is untouched and consistent.

Fallback elements (12-month cap, 30-day reduction notice, true-up) are unnecessary and correctly absent because no commitment survives; the residual phrase "in each of the next three years" is leftover original wording that is harmless once the minimum is zero, though a cleaner deletion of that phrase would read better.
